## Spec File
`.specs/010-alignment-audit.md`

## Objective
Audit every page of the Nexify website for CTA button and pillar/feature card misalignment, then apply all CSS fixes.

## Pages to Audit
- index.php (homepage)
- energy.php
- ecosystem.php
- virtual-office.php
- careers.php
- contact.php
- faq.php
- All other .php pages

## Horizontal Alignment Checks
- All CTA buttons share the same horizontal axis within their section
- Pillars/feature cards have equal width and consistent left/right padding
- Text inside buttons is centered (no off-center labels)
- Section containers respect the same max-width grid — confirm 1200px or 1320px

## Vertical Alignment Checks
- Buttons in a row share equal height (use `min-height`, not `auto`)
- Pillar cards have equal height regardless of content length — use `display:flex; align-items:stretch` on parent grid
- Icons inside pillars are vertically centered relative to their headings
- CTA button text is vertically centered (flex centering)

## Deliverable
For every misaligned element:
- Page URL
- CSS selector
- Current behavior vs expected
- Applied CSS fix in `css/style.css` and/or `css/responsive.css`

## Acceptance Criteria
- All CTA buttons + pillars pixel-aligned
- No layout shift on any page
- Verified via Playwright screenshot before/after
